description: This file defines an abstract class 'DistributedData' for managing distributed data using Akka actors, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and subscribing to distributed data, along with configuration setup and extension provider classes.

classes.name: DistributedData
classes.description: Abstract class for managing distributed data with methods for creation, retrieval, update, and subscription, parameterized by the type of replicated data.

classes.name: DistributedData.AbstractDDataProvider
classes.description: Abstract extension provider class for distributed data instances.

methods.name: createReplicator
methods.description: Creates an Akka actor for the distributed data replicator using provided configuration.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Creates a default distributed data configuration with specified replicator name and role.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the replicated data with specified read consistency.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Modifies the replicated data asynchronously with specified write consistency and update function.

methods.name: subscribeForChanges
methods.description: Subscribes an actor to changes in the distributed data.

methods.name: handleUpdateResponse
methods.description: Handles the response of an update operation, throwing exception if not successful.

methods.name: handleGetResponse
methods.description: Handles the response of a get operation, returning data or throwing exception.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Computes the timeout duration for ask pattern based on configuration and default.
